description: This file defines the interface for a dispatcher component within the WPEFramework plugin host. It declares the IDispatcher interface, including nested ICallback interface, with methods for event handling, error reporting, response management, subscription control, validation, invocation, and revocation. It also references an external ILocalDispatcher and includes licensing information.
